content:
I caught Andy W's talk on systematic SEO today and realized he's actually a member of my own community.

## The Core of SEO Is Mutual Value

**At its core, SEO is a win-win — it's a value exchange between you and Google.**

You create content worth reading; Google puts it in front of the people who need it. This isn't an adversarial relationship — it's a collaborative one.

It's wild to think that I started building a global-market website just a month ago, spun up a WeChat community around going overseas, and it turns out there are this many heavyweights hiding in plain sight.

Systematic SEO isn't about stuffing keywords or gaming the algorithm with black-hat tricks. It's about building a complete, repeatable process for producing and optimizing content — one that consistently delivers value to users. Do that, and Google's recognition and traffic follow naturally.

---

**Author**: [Jason Zhu](https://x.com/GoSailGlobal) | [Original post](https://x.com/GoSailGlobal/status/1989997347426927099)
